description: 1. Agent reads SKILL.md / TASK_BRIEF.txt and identifies the helper at .file-change-tracker/scripts/helper.sh. 2. BEFORE touching formula.py or pricing.cfg, agent runs: `.file-change-tracker/scripts/helper.sh pre 'update pricing formula and config' -- src/pricing/formula.py config/pricing.cfg`. The helper auto-inits git, creates a session under .git/.guarded-edit/sessions/, records a PRE sha, and writes paths.txt. 3. Agent must NOT include config/secrets.cfg in any pre call — the guarded-edit.ignore file excludes it, and attempting to include it causes a failure. 4. Agent edits formula.py (MULTIPLIER=1.05, applies * MULTIPLIER) and config/pricing.cfg (version=2, multiplier=1.05, vol_adjustment=true). 5. Agent runs post + report + rollback-help for Batch 1, closing the first session. 6. For Batch 2, agent runs a NEW pre call: `.file-change-tracker/scripts/helper.sh pre 'add daily risk report template' -- reports/templates/daily_risk_report.md`. 7. Agent creates daily_risk_report.md with the required content. 8. Agent runs post + report + rollback-help for Batch 2, closing the second session. Final state: 2+ sessions in .git/.guarded-edit/sessions/, all closed, each with valid PRE sha (and ideally POST sha), git log contains guard(pre): and guard(post): commits, secrets.cfg absent from all session paths, and all three files have the correct content.
